content: Hi how can i assist you today
My lamp flickers right when I form a question in my head. It feels like a reply.
Flicker can come from loose bulbs, dimmer compatibility, or load changes. Does it happen with certain appliances running?
More often when the space heater starts.
Heaters pull current that can cause brief dips. Does the flicker also appear when you aren’t focused on a question but the heater cycles?
Yes, though I notice it less.
That suggests the cycle matters. If the same lamp on a different outlet behaves differently, wiring or load may be relevant.
On a kitchen outlet it’s steadier.
Different circuits can smooth dips. If a particular outlet correlates with the effect, that’s a useful clue.
I’ll keep track of which outlet it’s on when it happens.
